title: Flood Risk Assessment Using Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis and GIS
description: This research employs GIS-based Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis (MCDA) to assess flood susceptibility in the southwest coastal region of Bangladesh, integrating remote sensing data with socio-economic vulnerability indicators to produce actionable flood risk maps.
question: How can GIS-based MCDA be used to generate accurate flood susceptibility maps for climate-vulnerable coastal regions of Bangladesh?
objectives: Map flood susceptibility using GIS and remote sensing data
Apply AHP-based MCDA for multi-criteria weighting
Validate results using historical flood records
methodology: MCDA, GIS Spatial Analysis, Remote Sensing, AHP

title: Urban Expansion and Its Impact on Green Spaces: A Remote Sensing Approach
description: Temporal analysis of urban growth patterns using Landsat time-series data to quantify the loss of green spaces and agricultural land due to rapid urbanization in secondary cities of Bangladesh.
question: What is the rate and spatial pattern of green space loss due to urban expansion in secondary Bangladeshi cities, and what planning interventions can mitigate these impacts?
objectives: Quantify urban expansion rates using multi-temporal satellite imagery
Map loss of green spaces and agricultural land
Analyze spatial patterns of urban growth
Propose evidence-based urban green space planning interventions
methodology: Remote Sensing, LULC Change Detection, Spatial Statistics, GIS Analysis

title: Climate Resilience Assessment of Coastal Urban Settlements
description: Research on building climate resilience in coastal urban settlements by analyzing exposure, sensitivity, and adaptive capacity using spatial data and community surveys in the context of Bangladesh's climate-vulnerable coastal zone.
question: What spatial and social factors determine climate resilience in coastal urban communities of Bangladesh, and how can spatial planning improve adaptive capacity?
objectives: Develop a climate resilience assessment framework for coastal cities
Map exposure, sensitivity, and adaptive capacity spatially
Conduct community surveys to assess social vulnerability
Recommend spatial planning strategies for resilience building
methodology: Resilience Index, GIS Analysis, Community Survey, Spatial Statistics, Vulnerability Assessment
